observedSource.worldTransform: identity (no xformOps on instance or mesh; verified via XformCache)

toolVersions.tooling: scratch TEMP venv + stdlib-only scripts (no numpy, no Docker, no Blender)

derivative.format: glTF 2.0 binary (GLB), 1 mesh, 1 TRIANGLES primitive, non-indexed soup
derivative.material: layoutlab-neutral-rack: baseColor [0.62, 0.64, 0.68, 1.0], metallic 0.0, roughness 0.9, doubleSided true
derivative.axisMap: (x, y, z)Z-up -> (x, z, -y)Y-up (proper rotation, det +1; winding preserved)
derivative.originMap: ground origin preserved: source z=0 -> GLB y=0
derivative.scaleBaked: none: GLB keeps source meters; per-rack canonical scaling is applied in the browser

canonicalScaling.rule: per rack: scale = (widthM / 3.999977, heightM / 3.010001, depthM / 2.066581); position = (centerXMm * 0.001, 0, centerZMm * 0.001); rotationY = yawDeg. Scale applies in mesh-local space before yaw, so yaw 90/270 swaps the world footprint exactly like the core footprint convention. The evaluator never reads the visual mesh.

discardedFeatures: SimReady physics payloads and MuJoCo/Newton/PhysX variants (GLB conversion does NOT preserve SimReady physics metadata)
GeomSubset material splits (2 subsets merged into one neutral material)
UVs (present in source, unused by the untextured material)
MDL materials (OmniPBR.mdl) and UDIM PNG textures (never downloaded; original MDL not preserved)
validation metadata (Robotics-Prop 3.1.0 feature checks) and runtime-testing metadata
conformance and packaging metadata (kept only as provenance records, not in the GLB)

integration.racks: actual GLB loaded in the browser 3D view (one instance per rack with canonical scale/yaw)
integration.otherObjects: location markers, packing marker, and route line remain labeled DEVELOPMENT PROXIES
integration.evaluatorDependence: none: measurement uses core geometry only; the 2D plan is unaffected
